newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Labour Minister Alexandru Athanasiu presented a parliament comission measures included in the government's social protection programme.
* Trade unions across the country plan series of strikes if the government fails to announce social protection measures this month.
* Romanian President Emil Constantinescu met in Paris French President Jaques Chirac.
